title: Caption app promo — before/after clips, a style picker in the hand, the edit running step by step, finished videos on four phones, logo lockup

source.author: @itsolelehmann
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after an AI-made promo for a captions app; the scene order, the before/after split, the chip sequence and the cut rhythm follow it. The real app's name, logo, store badge and creators are replaced with a fictional brand, generic UI and generated people. The original is live video; this template uses still photos generated with the Claude Imagine MCP and fakes motion with handheld sway, push-ins, cut kicks and motion blur. Every phone screen is live HTML mapped onto a green-screen phone photo with a matrix3d homography, so the UI stays sharp and editable.

scenes: a clip with a 'Generate edit' button; the cursor clicks it
the clip splits into Before and After cards (motion blur); the After card gets a tracking frame and word-by-word captions, over three clips
the logo wipes in large over the cards, then the scene blurs away
a hand holds a phone with a grid of caption styles; it scrolls and one style is picked
the edit runs on a phone at a garden party: chips for captions, b-roll and music turn from working to done, then 'Done!'
four quick cuts of finished edits on phones lying on tables
a wall of four creator clips, each with its own caption style
the icon pops in, wobbles, moves left and the wordmark and store line fade in

A friendly woman in her early 30s with long light-brown hair and a pale green t-shirt talks to the camera mid-sentence in a sunny suburban backyard in early spring. Behind her on the left, a black gas grill with burgers and corn cobs sizzling; bare trees, a wooden fence and a patchy lawn in the background. Bright midday sun, natural skin texture, slight wide-angle distortion, authentic UGC vlog look. No text, no logos.

notes: To swap a phone photo: generate one with a flat green screen, run `python3 tools/screen_quad.py photo.png assets/img/name.webp` (THR=100,35 for darker greens), and paste the printed corners into QB, QC or QD in index.html. The picker, the editor and the creator captions are plain HTML/CSS, so restyling them is a CSS edit. The picked style must be one of the names in `styles`. Credits used for the demo: 8 gpt-image-2.5 images (24) + 3 z-image (3) = 27.
